SettingsView_Agent_ToolTip: Agent runtime used by the AI assistant.
SettingsView_AutoDiscovery_ToolTip: Automatically discover kubeconfig files in the default kubeconfig directory.
SettingsView_DisableJsonSerializationRef: Disables reflection fallback for Kubernetes JSON serialization. When enabled, missing generated metadata will fail instead of using reflection. Reflection is enabled by default and requires runtime support.
SettingsView_Logging_ToolTip: KubeUI logs to the local file system in the <User Profile>/.kubeui/app.log
SettingsView_McpClientClusters_Descripti: No checked clusters means all clusters, including clusters added later. Check one or more to limit this client to those clusters.
SettingsView_McpClientName_Duplicate: A client with this name already exists.
SettingsView_McpClientName_TooLong: Client name must be 80 characters or fewer.
SettingsView_McpClientName_Watermark: For example, Codex or Claude Code
SettingsView_McpClients_Description: Create a separate bearer token for each trusted host app. KubeUI stores only token verifiers. ConfigMaps, custom resources, and pod logs may contain credentials; Secret reads still require approval.
SettingsView_McpEnabled_ToolTip: Starts the embedded MCP server on localhost so MCP clients can control this KubeUI instance.
SettingsView_McpPort_ToolTip: Hostname and path are fixed to 127.0.0.1 and /mcp. Change only the port when you need to avoid a local conflict.
SettingsView_McpServerUnavailable: MCP server is not listening. Check whether another process is using the configured port. Do not connect external clients until KubeUI is listening.
SettingsView_McpTokenCreateFailed: Token was not created. Revoke unused tokens or check that KubeUI settings storage is available.
SettingsView_McpTokenCreated: Token created. Copy it now; KubeUI will not show it again.
SettingsView_McpTokenInvalid: Client details are invalid. Check that the name is unique and cluster selection contains no more than 100 valid clusters.
SettingsView_McpTokenRevokeFailed: Revocation was not saved. This token remains active until KubeUI can save the change.
SettingsView_McpTokenRevoked: Token revoked. It can no longer access MCP.
SettingsView_PreRelease_ToolTip: Allows updates to pre-release versions of KubeUI
SettingsView_Telemetry_ToolTip: KubeUI gathers telemetry data to help the team improve the product.
